notes.note: Re-read against the qualification failure manifest change: the Vitest corpus runner, phase driver and e2e suite write a structured failure manifest only when STATION_QUALIFICATION_MANIFEST_DIR is set, corpus and Android jobs upload it on failure, and the repair and health trackers classify red runs from it in report mode unless STATION_QUALIFICATION_SIGNAL is enforce. No test selection, verdict, permission or release behaviour changes. This document makes no claim about those behaviors; no prose change needed. The three new child-process tests are classified in vitest-resource-manifest.mjs, as this guide requires.
